applicabilityBasis.summary: STAC represents tokenized shares of Securitize AAA CLO Tokenized Fund, Ltd., an investment fund investing substantially all assets in USD-denominated AAA collateralized-loan-obligation tranches. Eligible investors subscribe for digital fund shares and fractional ownership, with investment risk rather than an issuer obligation to pay a fixed dollar amount. The GENIUS section 2(22)(B)(iii) securities exclusion applies.

genius.notes: The SEC Form D index establishes the exact fund filer and a November 5, 2025 exempt-offering notice; it is not SEC approval, GENIUS authorization or a finding about compliance with an exemption. The issuer announcement identifies Ethereum tokenized shares, accreditation/KYC eligibility, AAA CLO investments, BNY services and investment/illiquidity risks. Securitize and BNY service-provider roles do not establish bank deposits or PPSI status. ReserveDisclosurePresent and monthlyAttestationPresent are omitted because fund portfolio assets are not payment-stablecoin reserves. Domicile and specific Rule 506/Investment Company Act exemption claims are deliberately omitted because the available SEC extraction did not expose the definitive offering terms.
